# Native launcher review images

Screenshot assets for the proposed native iOS launcher changes. These files are hosted on a separate review-assets branch so they do not enter the implementation diff.

Before: historical main `8d13135`. Current iPhone/iPad after: ShellDemo 1.0 (53), captured on base `12b07ae1`. The feature branch subsequently integrated `d656d64e`; its English layouts are unchanged. Duo device-frame comparisons are historical and do not establish final hardware validation.

See `FINAL-CAPTURE-MANIFEST.json` for the exact paths, dimensions, and SHA-256 digests. All artwork is fictional demo content.
